title: Fix the claude usage adapter's cumulative-token measurement and status precedence (external report)
summary: One bounded fix cycle in the kit's dispatch adapter answering an external report: the claude usage adapter divided the run's cumulative token sum by the context window (ratio 20 on an 83-turn run) and the resulting state overwrote a gates-failed outcome as continuation_required with no artifact. Under the frozen envelope, multi-turn usage becomes informational with a null ratio, single-turn usage keeps its ratio, status is decided by gates and a continuation status requires a valid artifact, the prompt names the working directory, cost is asserted never to be spend, plus a fixture test on the reported envelope. Frozen launch command texts unchanged.
